description: Per-file content provenance for the W2 methodology skills, separate from the W1 moved-role fixture test/fixtures/provenance.json. Source hashes are SHA-256 of the blob at the pinned commit under the inventory source root.

files.explanation: Hub adapted from the pi-mimir hub with Cursor context. Preserves the triggers, all 24 principle summaries, Autonomy, reply and comment rules and the 23-playbook routing table. Replaces set_tasks, poteto-agent, role/tasks/chain parameters, model defaults and the shell-confirmation guard claim with a visible checklist, deliberate bare delegates, task categories and behavioral authorization. Adds activation, availability and per-reference planned fallbacks. W2 no-role amendment (docs/plans/09-wave2-no-poteto-role.md): the retired poteto role is no longer named; every delegate is bare, and no role is required. W3 reconcile: the 24 principle summaries name their shipped leaves without markers and the preamble says to read the leaf in full before citing it; the availability section lists the W3 skills that ship; W3 interim clauses for benchmark-checklist, unslop, technical-writing and no-comments are retired, restoring the upstream trigger wording; adds the D6 routing line for typescript-best-practices (explicit-only) and the comment-sicko delegate as the worked bare-specialist example. W4 routes stay marked.

Replaces /loop with automatic subagent delivery and a bounded bare watcher child; states that autonomy is not external-action authority; show-me-your-work planned W4 with a local decision-log fallback. W3 reconcile: the principle-sequence-verifiable-units marker is retired now that the leaf ships.

Replaces control-skill, /loop and model-default wording with project tooling, an explicit stop-condition loop and bare implementer task:coding delegation; marks how/why/architect planned with manual equivalents; commits and PR gated by task authorization. W2 no-role amendment: implementation goes to a bare implementer instead of the retired poteto role. W3 reconcile: the tdd and principle markers and the tdd interim clause are retired, restoring the upstream tdd sentence.

Keeps the throughput checkpoint and mandatory delegation; delegates to a bare implementer with task categories; marks how/architect/arena/interrogate planned with safe manual equivalents; leaf delegates own the diff when further delegation is not authorized; PR only when authorized. W2 no-role amendment: implementation goes to a bare implementer instead of the retired poteto role. W3 reconcile: the three principle markers are retired now that the leaves ship.
Routes how/why to planned W4 with a direct read-only investigation fallback; unslop step restored to the upstream wording at the W3 reconcile, when unslop shipped.

Runs only when the task authorizes a pull request; replaces Cursor/deslop and git reset guidance with a manual cleanup pass and pi-herdr-agents managed worktrees; keeps title, description, forge, stack and readiness rules; babysit and autopilot owners planned W4. W3 reconcile: no-comments, technical-writing and unslop markers and their interim fallbacks are retired now that those skills ship.
Stops launched children with recorded state and retained worktrees; wip commit only when the commit policy allows; no push or PR to pause unless already authorized.

Keeps the mantras and measurement story; benchmark-checklist routed as shipped (its W3 marker and Explain the Number fallback retired at the W3 reconcile); hillclimb playbook planned W4; bare implementer task:coding delegation; PR only when authorized. W2 no-role amendment: implementation goes to a bare implementer instead of the retired poteto role. W3 reconcile: the principle-sequence-verifiable-units marker is retired.

Keeps the throwaway decision method; uses session-provided search and screenshot tooling with an explicit unverified label when absent; keeps scratch work out of commits and project dependencies. W3 reconcile: the principle-exhaust-the-design-space marker is retired now that the leaf ships.

Keeps the pinned-contract method; normalizes principle references to full skill names (their planned W3 markers retired at the W3 reconcile); replaces control-skill smoke runs with project tooling; delegates to a bare implementer; PR only when authorized. W2 no-role amendment: implementation goes to a bare implementer instead of the retired poteto role.

Replaces the control skill with session/project profiling tooling and limits live instrumentation to local processes the agent owns; principle reference uses the full skill name; its planned W3 marker retired at the W3 reconcile.

Uses Pi session files ($PI_SESSION_FILE and the per-directory session store) instead of Cursor transcripts; recall planned W4; prior authority does not carry over. W3 reconcile: the two principle markers are retired now that the leaves ship.
Unchanged method; principle reference normalized to its full skill name; its planned W3 marker retired at the W3 reconcile.
New W2 shared reference expanding the upstream Autonomy section: sources of authority, commit policy, the explicit-authorization list, autonomy grants, delegate authority and the not-a-sandbox rule.

Rubric and learned patterns unchanged. Thread replies and resolution now require authorization; Babysit route marked planned W4; new patterns are proposed to the source repository instead of edited into an installed copy.

New W2 shared reference replacing the upstream Subagents defaults: deliberate bare delegates with reference prompts, the child brief, task-category and exact-model independence rules, and schema-valid single-call examples for pi-herdr-agents e262c584. W2 no-role amendment: adds the bounded Implementer prompt (written for this reference, not copied from the retired poteto role) and makes every example bare.

Substantially rewritten from the Cursor onboarding skill. Drops the Cursor rule file, model-budget ladder, per-role model map and aliases. Keeps detection, current-state loading, validation against available models and the optional verification-skill check, now as guidance around the extension's code-built report on pi-herdr-agents shared task preferences. W2 runtime revision: describes the /setup-pstack change flow, where the extension validates one proposal, shows the complete conditional writer payload for explicit approval and verifies the saved file; direct skill use stays informational. W2 no-role amendment and review fixes: removes the poteto role and override lines, states that an explicit model argument (exact or task:<category>) wins over role, per-agent and default models, and reports post-dispatch outcomes from the saved file. W2 unconditional writer gate: states that every direct writer call, including /subagents-init, is refused while pstack is installed and names /setup-pstack <request> as the replacement. W3 reconcile: adds that /skill:no-comments launches its comment editor as a bare delegate, not a role.
